# [G1 — Warming](../hypodrafts/G1.md "Warming")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_g1.py` from the draft as committed at `c601feb`. Counts of files held in this repository are read live. Counts that session made from external sources or from one-off runs are quotations of that commit - what the draft reported, shown as such, not re-derived by the build.*


Draft only. Counts verified by reading the files; the pilot slopes below **carry no null**,
so none is a result.

## The claim, and why it needs splitting before it can be tested

[G1](../hypodrafts/G1.md "Warming") predicts "monotone worsening independent of load", and offers that as why load reduction
has not produced recovery. But warming reaches near-bed oxygen by three routes —
**solubility** (deterministic, Weiss 1970), **stratification** ([C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength")'s object) and **metabolic
rate** (Q10, unmeasured here) — only the first of which is policy-inert. So [G1](../hypodrafts/G1.md "Warming")'s testable
content is not *does oxygen fall* but **what fraction of the long-term fall is
thermodynamics**: the seasonal decomposition done here ([23](../SOURCES.md#F-34fc22b1dc)-fold → [14](../SOURCES.md#F-0d542829cb)-fold on a saturation
threshold, ~[40](../SOURCES.md#F-367b80b53a) % thermodynamic), moved onto the long-term axis.

## Observable consequence, stated to be falsified

Per station-month, `C_sat` = Weiss (1970) from near-bed T and S, mL/L × [1.42905](../SOURCES.md#F-34bf5e8dd2):

> `O_bed = C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) − D`,  so  `dO/dt ≡ dC_sat/dt − dD/dt`.

`C_sat` is exact and external, so the first term is **computed, not estimated**. The deficit
`D` is solubility-neutral by construction and carries the rest: consumption, failed
ventilation, advection.

**G1-a:** *the decline is not mostly solubility* — `dC_sat/dt` is a minority of `dO/dt`.
Falsified if the solubility term equals or exceeds the observed decline.

**G1-b:** *`dD/dt > 0`* — the deficit widens, as it must if warming drives respiration or
stratification faster than ventilation recovers. Falsified by `dD/dt ≤ 0`, or by a `dD/dt`
indistinguishable from the year-block null. G1-b carries the load-independence claim; G1-a
decides whom the finding is about.

## Data, with verified counts

`docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` — [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months, [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) stations, months
[0](../SOURCES.md#F-522bd018c5)–[560](../SOURCES.md#F-a57d077005) (Jan 1980 – Sep 2026). Five-way join `oxy_bed ∩ temp_bed ∩ sal_bed ∩ temp_surf ∩
sal_surf`: **[76,309](../SOURCES.md#F-d652a54a80)**; after plausibility ([0](../SOURCES.md#F-72ff512e6b) ≤ O ≤ [20](../SOURCES.md#F-f674082953), −[2](../SOURCES.md#F-2feb21dfa3) ≤ T ≤ [30](../SOURCES.md#F-ff83f85ae2), [0](../SOURCES.md#F-5bddcec7cc) ≤ S ≤ [40](../SOURCES.md#F-b80834218b) at both
depths) **[76,264](../SOURCES.md#F-d3543bb345) rows, [1,314](../SOURCES.md#F-d3b1637485) stations, 1980–2026**.

Trend panel = cells (station × calendar month) with ≥ [8](../SOURCES.md#F-a678c57c0b) distinct years **and** ≥ [15](../SOURCES.md#F-5ee2ad4a2a)-year
span: **[2,429](../SOURCES.md#F-c349be081c) cells · [54,211](../SOURCES.md#F-ffd3486149) rows · [310](../SOURCES.md#F-abb074f85a) stations**. Balanced variant (cell in both 1990–1999
and 2015–2026): [1,282](../SOURCES.md#F-e4c88e714c) cells · [35,215](../SOURCES.md#F-f342ea70d0) rows. Rows per half-decade fall [14,491](../SOURCES.md#F-3730cf147d) (1990–1994) → [6,842](../SOURCES.md#F-346b9d99c2)
(2020–2024): the network thins, which is the composition problem.

**Error classes.** class 1, value — `oxy_bed` −[9.93](../SOURCES.md#F-aca39a02c7) to [281.6](../SOURCES.md#F-b154ef87b7) mg/l, `temp_surf` to [80.3](../SOURCES.md#F-1ae1a33ab9) °C; [45](../SOURCES.md#F-e155becf7d) rows
removed. class 2, quantisation — one-decimal T; ±[0.05](../SOURCES.md#F-b6ba905e97) °C is ±[0.015](../SOURCES.md#F-8388e2ab75) mg/l in `C_sat`, which
matters for a single value, not a slope. class 3, aggregation — monthly medians, so
`D` may pair T, S and O from different casts. class 5, unfilled — [12,736](../SOURCES.md#F-b28667e766) `oxy_bed` cells carry no
archived saturation. class 6, **no time-of-day column anywhere** (`ctd.csv.gz` has `Dato` as
`19701013`); if sampling hour drifted over [47](../SOURCES.md#F-9caf2c0bff) years, the diel oxygen cycle drifted with it,
uncorrectably — the one class that caps this test rather than bounds it. class 7, avoided: the
unit is a station, and no water body is needed, every estimate being within-cell.

## Circularity, avoided

Archived `oxysat_bed` is computed from O, T and S, so it already contains temperature.
**It is never an outcome here.** `D` contains T through `C_sat` deliberately — that is the
*subtraction* of the solubility channel, Weiss being external to the archive; and errors in
T enter `D` but not the year regressor, so they add noise, not trend. Worked through in
[`C6.md`](C6.md); not restated.

## The null, computed under the constraint actually imposed

Not "zero slope". The estimator is a within-cell FE slope on year; the constraint imposed is
*within station and within calendar month*. Under it I measured the dependence the textbook
SE ignores:

- Autocorrelation of within-cell detrended `D` residuals at annual spacing: first-lag mean
  **−[0.048](../SOURCES.md#F-7ae69a15a5)**, second-lag **−[0.057](../SOURCES.md#F-32351309dc)** over [2,312](../SOURCES.md#F-23fec73781) cells — indistinguishable from detrending's own
  −[1](../SOURCES.md#F-a0b2e0837a)/(n−[1](../SOURCES.md#F-c6fb475e6e)) ≈ −[0.05](../SOURCES.md#F-324d9e3e61) bias. **Temporal AR is not the problem here.**
- The dependence is *cross-sectional*: SD of the year-mean residual **[0.2513](../SOURCES.md#F-94c98c2b30)** where
  independence predicts **[0.0471](../SOURCES.md#F-9aeed78ac6)** — variance inflation **[28.4](../SOURCES.md#F-c6a2908abb)**. All cells in a year sample the same weather.

So the null is a **year-block procedure**: resample the [47](../SOURCES.md#F-6a51950b42) calendar years with replacement,
and separately permute year labels attached to whole years; refit, [2,000](../SOURCES.md#F-15749c7dc2) draws. That keeps
every station effect, the seasonal cycle and the within-year common shock, destroying only
the year→outcome ordering. Consequence: the naive SE on `dD/dt` ([0.00061](../SOURCES.md#F-9cfa7e3ece) mg/l/yr)
understates by ≈ √[28.4](../SOURCES.md#F-0129378601) ≈ **[5.3](../SOURCES.md#F-bce0d066d7)×**, to ≈ [0.0032](../SOURCES.md#F-e17856c8cb). A quoted null would have been wrong by that
factor.

## Composition, handled

The phenology mix moves. On my own definition (≥ [8](../SOURCES.md#F-9fe5ed9982) `oxy_bed` months; ≥ [65](../SOURCES.md#F-aa9bc3e9d4) % in May–Oct →
"summer-peaked"): **[282](../SOURCES.md#F-189463b946) summer-peaked vs [480](../SOURCES.md#F-c9bfc7d201) year-round**, the summer-peaked running
**[1.25](../SOURCES.md#F-fa4fcac549) mg/l lower** in May–Oct ([6.31](../SOURCES.md#F-89792d3ff7) vs [7.56](../SOURCES.md#F-364b0ed5fd), d **[0.50](../SOURCES.md#F-65928b4520)**, n = [12,390](../SOURCES.md#F-61db0bef4b) / [32,924](../SOURCES.md#F-474a9bee18)), their share
of station-months moving **[29.5](../SOURCES.md#F-ecd7224664) % (2010–2014) → [16.4](../SOURCES.md#F-91db5be0b1) % (2015–2019)**. Direction and size reproduce the figure
on file ([293](../SOURCES.md#F-f92ce1e9d6) / [481](../SOURCES.md#F-01107225e9), [1.57](../SOURCES.md#F-ed54d61dfe) mg/l, d [0.66](../SOURCES.md#F-a2df8385e6), [32](../SOURCES.md#F-a33cec8d87)→[12](../SOURCES.md#F-01473270d8) %); the split is threshold-dependent, which is
itself the warning.

Three defences, all required: (i) within-cell FE, so a station only competes with itself;
(ii) the balanced panel, so entry and exit cannot tilt the slope; (iii) phenology × year.

## Procedure

1. Read the five arrays at the `.json` offsets, key `station×1000 + month`, filter → [76,264](../SOURCES.md#F-9b89e9260f);
   compute `C_sat` (Weiss) and `D`; build the ≥ [8](../SOURCES.md#F-fdfcac09a8)-year / ≥ [15](../SOURCES.md#F-252ee52d09)-span panel.
2. FE slopes on year for `O`, `C_sat`, `D`, `T_bed`, `T_surf − T_bed`. The first three satisfy
   the identity exactly; report the split as a **fraction of `dO/dt`**, not a p-value.
3. Year-block null (above) for each; report naive SE, block SE and their ratio.
4. Repeat balanced, Jun–Sep, Dec–Mar, and with the phenology interaction. **Agreement across
   all five is the finding; disagreement is equally the finding.**
5. Refit `dD/dt` with surface-minus-bed density as a covariate — this *uses* [C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength")'s variable and
   does not test it. What survives is the metabolic-plus-unknown residue, a residue not a Q10.

### What the pilot already shows (no null attached — not yet a result)

On the [2,429](../SOURCES.md#F-85d301f231)-cell panel, per decade: `T_bed` **+[0.42](../SOURCES.md#F-b412cda46e) °C**, `C_sat` **−[0.099](../SOURCES.md#F-11f392c50d) mg/l**, `O_bed`
**−[0.046](../SOURCES.md#F-7c943a8aa1) mg/l**, `D` **−[0.053](../SOURCES.md#F-680967fcd6) mg/l**. The solubility term exceeds the whole observed
decline; the deficit appears to *narrow*. But `dD/dt` sits ~[1.6](../SOURCES.md#F-92b2913e7e) block-SE from zero and moves
to −[0.031](../SOURCES.md#F-678ab8e400) (balanced), −[0.088](../SOURCES.md#F-fdef5dd832) (Jun–Sep), −[0.040](../SOURCES.md#F-e16774f7b8) (Dec–Mar) — spread wider than its own
uncertainty. Surface-minus-bed temperature difference **−[0.027](../SOURCES.md#F-05f019eb04) °C/decade**: no detectable
strengthening of thermal stratification here.

## What a result would and would not license

**Would.** If `dC_sat/dt` matches or exceeds `dO/dt` under the year-block null and across all
five sensitivities, that licenses: *at these [310](../SOURCES.md#F-7c39910bf2) stations the long-term near-bed oxygen
decline is accounted for by the solubility ceiling alone, and the non-thermodynamic deficit
did not widen.* That constrains [G1](../hypodrafts/G1.md "Warming")'s headline directly: "monotone worsening independent of
load" would be true of the water and still not evidence that load reduction failed, the
falling term being the one no load policy touches.

**Would not.** It does not measure respiration and cannot: `D` is a standing stock, Q10 a
rate, and converting between them needs a ventilation timescale the archive lacks (class 6).
A narrowing `D` is equally consistent with load reduction working *and* with the network
drifting toward better-ventilated positions — (i)–(iii) bound that, they do not eliminate
it. It says nothing about stratification beyond a two-point difference at sampling depth, which
is no pycnocline ([C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength")'s object; believe [C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength") here), nothing about water bodies, nothing about
the [1,004](../SOURCES.md#F-206f238b0c) stations the span filter drops. And `dD/dt ≈ 0` refutes G1-b only at the
resolution of monthly medians taken at an unrecorded hour.
